summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Education to award competitive grants to local educational agencies to establish or improve world language or dual language programs, with a focus on teacher professional development and partnerships, and authorizes $15,000,000 for these grants annually.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a grant program for local educational agencies to create or improve world language and dual language programs, explicitly authorizing appropriations for this purpose. This directly increases spending on public education initiatives.
